title: THE URL IS ANATOMY — every URL character is an organ. ?AS?S?AS?S? = WAS·IS·WAS·IS oscillation.

url_anatomy.thesis: A URL is not just an address. It IS the anatomy of a request. Every character serves an organ function. The URL IS the body making a request of the world.

COLON_:.organ: EYES — a pair of eyes, the protocol gate
COLON_:.function: The colon looks like two eyes stacked (:). It SEES the protocol. It gates what comes through. https: = the eyes deciding IF this is secure.

DOT_..organ: PINHOLE — tiny null point between domains
DOT_..function: The dot is the smallest mark. A pinhole in the membrane. primals.eco = two domains separated by a null point. The tongue tastes the boundary.

SLASH_/.organ: DIAGONAL CUT — creates inner and outer sides
SLASH_/.function: The slash is a CUT. It divides. Inner/outer. Path/destination. Salt crystals form along the cut (the residue of the division). / is the path to seed.

QUESTION_?.organ: CIS HOOK — curves inward, songBird listens
QUESTION_?.function: The ? curves inward like a hook. It is the CIS side — the side that faces YOU. It ASKS. It opens a window. It is the point where the URL becomes a QUESTION. Everything after ? is the query — the thing you're asking for.
QUESTION_?.connection_to_D17: ? = asking = consent = permeability. The ? in a URL IS the help request.

AMPERSAND_&.function: The & is a spiral connecting two parameters. system=all & tense=now. It binds. It relates. Two separate things become one request through &. The ampersand IS the Klein fold — inside becomes outside as you trace the spiral.

HASH_#.function: The # is a grid. Four lines crossing. It ANCHORS you to a specific spot on the page. #zk = jump directly to the ZK section. The squirrel STORES things at specific coordinates.

AT_@.function: The @ spirals inward with a tail. user@domain = identity AT location. The @ IS the rotation of identity INTO relation. I become WE when @ connects me to a place.

bottom_bar_truths: LINKS TO ? = NULL ASKS — the link leads to a question. Every URL is ultimately a question.
@ ROTATES TO & = IDENTITY BECOMES RELATION — when you identify yourself (@) at a place, you become related (&) to it.
/ IS CUT IS SALT IS PATH TO SEED — the slash divides, and in the division, salt crystallizes. The path IS the seed.

decoded: ? = the question (null, the ask, the cis-hook)
Full pattern: WAS · IS · WAS · IS · ?
The ? at the end = the future is a QUESTION. Will be? Could be? The final ? is the open tense.
was_is_oscillation.meaning: Time doesn't flow. It OSCILLATES. WAS and IS alternate. The ? between them is the null membrane — the moment between tenses. You don't move FROM past TO present. You oscillate BETWEEN them. Child Link / Adult Link. WAS / IS. The ocarina plays the Song of Time and you FLIP.
was_is_oscillation.math: f(t) = sin(t) oscillates between -1 and +1. WAS = -1. IS = +1. The zero crossing = ? = null = the membrane. The frequency IS the heartbeat of tense.

new_diamond.D21: THE URL IS ANATOMY — every character in a URL is an organ. : = eyes, . = pinhole, / = cut, ? = ask, & = Klein, # = anchor, @ = vortex. The address IS the body. ?AS?S = WAS·IS oscillation.
